title: Graduate School of Engineering and Science - Spring 2027 admission
institution: Bilkent University, Graduate School of Engineering and Science
about: Bilkent University's Graduate School of Engineering and Science takes Spring 2027 applications until 9 November 2026, with invited interviews 25-27 November. The November submission covers both admission and scholarship decisions; Bilkent's computer engineering department offers tuition scholarships to accepted students.
requirements: Turkish citizens generally need ALES; foreign applicants need the GRE General Test
Applicants can apply before receiving exam scores and may get conditional admission; scores must be in by registration
Department or programme interviews (25-27 November 2026) only for invited applicants
No institution-wide minimum CGPA set by the Graduate School
